enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Sleep.

Wake up. Sit up on bed. Swing legs over edge. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands. Apply soap to face. Rinse face. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Place bowl on counter. Pick up cereal box. Pour cereal into bowl. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Pour milk into bowl. Close refrigerator. Pick up spoon. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Stand up. Place bowl and spoon in sink. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Get dressed and prepare for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to bathroom. Pick up toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Walk to bedroom. Pick up bag. Open bag. Put in phone. Put in wallet. Close bag. Pick up keys. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to door. Exit bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital.

Walk to therapy room. Turn on light. Check equipment. Greet patient. Assist patient with exercises. Demonstrate exercise. Adjust patient's posture. Write notes on computer. Walk to waiting area. Call next patient. Greet patient. Assist patient with exercises. Demonstrate exercise. Adjust patient's posture. Write notes on computer. Walk to break room. Drink water. Walk back to therapy room.

Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Carry tray to table. Sit down. Pick up fork. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Pick up napkin. Wipe mouth. Stand up. Carry tray to return area. Walk out of cafeteria. Walk to break room. Sit on chair. Rest.

Walk to therapy room. Turn on light. Check equipment. Greet patient. Assist patient with exercises. Demonstrate exercise. Adjust patient's posture. Write notes on computer. Walk to waiting area. Call next patient. Greet patient. Assist patient with exercises. Demonstrate exercise. Adjust patient's posture. Write notes on computer. Walk to break room. Drink water. Walk back to therapy room.
Walk out of hospital. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to door. Exit bus. Walk to home. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Help Member 2 with cooking dinner (joint activity)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Greet Member 2. Wash hands. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Close refrigerator. Place vegetables on cutting board. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Member 2 says, "Can you stir the pot?" Stir pot.
Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat food. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Talk to Member 2. Pick up napkin. Wipe mouth. Member 2 asks about work. Reply, "Busy day."
Stand up. Pick up plates. Carry to sink. Rinse plates. Load dishwasher. Wipe counter. Put away leftovers. Member 2 says, "Thanks for helping." Reply, "No problem."

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Flip channels. Stop on a show. Put down remote. Watch TV. Laugh. Talk to Member 2. Adjust pillow. Get up to get water. Walk to kitchen. Pour water. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Continue watching TV.

Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Type password. Open browser. Browse websites. Watch videos. Type messages. Close laptop. Stand up. Stretch. Turn off desk lamp. Lie on bed. Pick up phone. Scroll through phone. Put down phone.
Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Adjust pillow. Lie down. Continue reading. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off light. Close eyes.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Apply cleanser. Rinse face. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.
Walk to bedroom. Lie on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Adjust blanket. Read more. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off light. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Sleep.
